panels.description: Stored display-timeline start for the selected trip. Capture UTC and display-time basis remain in the evidence panel.

targets.queryText: SELECT timeline_start_ms AS "Trip start" FROM trip WHERE trip_id = ${trip:sqlstring} AND device_id = ${device:sqlstring} LIMIT 1
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT timeline_start_ms AS "Trip start" FROM trip WHERE trip_id = ${trip:sqlstring} AND device_id = ${device:sqlstring} LIMIT 1

panels.title: Trip start

panels.description: Duration between stored display-timeline bounds for the selected trip.

targets.queryText: SELECT (timeline_end_ms - timeline_start_ms) / 1000.0 AS "Duration" FROM trip WHERE trip_id = ${trip:sqlstring} AND device_id = ${device:sqlstring} LIMIT 1
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT (timeline_end_ms - timeline_start_ms) / 1000.0 AS "Duration" FROM trip WHERE trip_id = ${trip:sqlstring} AND device_id = ${device:sqlstring} LIMIT 1

panels.title: Duration

panels.description: Stored device trip distance at the latest sample in the selected range, converted to miles. Missing PID 0x030 remains unavailable.

targets.queryText: SELECT m.numeric_value * 0.621371 AS "Distance" FROM sample_metric AS m JOIN sample AS s ON s.device_id = m.device_id AND s.trip_id = m.trip_id AND s.sequence = m.sequence WHERE m.device_id = ${device:sqlstring} AND m.trip_id = ${trip:sqlstring} AND m.pid = '0x030' AND s.timeline_ms BETWEEN CAST($__from AS INTEGER) AND CAST($__to AS INTEGER) ORDER BY s.sequence DESC LIMIT 1
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT m.numeric_value * 0.621371 AS "Distance" FROM sample_metric AS m JOIN sample AS s ON s.device_id = m.device_id AND s.trip_id = m.trip_id AND s.sequence = m.sequence WHERE m.device_id = ${device:sqlstring} AND m.trip_id = ${trip:sqlstring} AND m.pid = '0x030' AND s.timeline_ms BETWEEN CAST($__from AS INTEGER) AND CAST($__to AS INTEGER) ORDER BY s.sequence DESC LIMIT 1

panels.title: Distance

panels.description: Average stored OBD speed in the selected range, converted to mph. Missing PID 0x10D remains unavailable.

targets.queryText: SELECT AVG(m.numeric_value * 0.621371) AS "Average speed (mph)" FROM sample_metric AS m JOIN sample AS s ON s.device_id = m.device_id AND s.trip_id = m.trip_id AND s.sequence = m.sequence WHERE m.device_id = ${device:sqlstring} AND m.trip_id = ${trip:sqlstring} AND m.pid = '0x10D' AND timeline_ms BETWEEN CAST($__from AS INTEGER) AND CAST($__to AS INTEGER)
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT AVG(m.numeric_value * 0.621371) AS "Average speed (mph)" FROM sample_metric AS m JOIN sample AS s ON s.device_id = m.device_id AND s.trip_id = m.trip_id AND s.sequence = m.sequence WHERE m.device_id = ${device:sqlstring} AND m.trip_id = ${trip:sqlstring} AND m.pid = '0x10D' AND timeline_ms BETWEEN CAST($__from AS INTEGER) AND CAST($__to AS INTEGER)

panels.title: Average speed

panels.description: Maximum stored OBD speed in the selected range, converted to mph. Missing PID 0x10D remains unavailable.

targets.queryText: SELECT MAX(m.numeric_value * 0.621371) AS "Maximum speed (mph)" FROM sample_metric AS m JOIN sample AS s ON s.device_id = m.device_id AND s.trip_id = m.trip_id AND s.sequence = m.sequence WHERE m.device_id = ${device:sqlstring} AND m.trip_id = ${trip:sqlstring} AND m.pid = '0x10D' AND timeline_ms BETWEEN CAST($__from AS INTEGER) AND CAST($__to AS INTEGER)
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT MAX(m.numeric_value * 0.621371) AS "Maximum speed (mph)" FROM sample_metric AS m JOIN sample AS s ON s.device_id = m.device_id AND s.trip_id = m.trip_id AND s.sequence = m.sequence WHERE m.device_id = ${device:sqlstring} AND m.trip_id = ${trip:sqlstring} AND m.pid = '0x10D' AND timeline_ms BETWEEN CAST($__from AS INTEGER) AND CAST($__to AS INTEGER)

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT MAX(m.numeric_value) AS "Peak engine speed" FROM sample_metric AS m JOIN sample AS s ON s.device_id = m.device_id AND s.trip_id = m.trip_id AND s.sequence = m.sequence WHERE m.device_id = ${device:sqlstring} AND m.trip_id = ${trip:sqlstring} AND m.pid = '0x10C' AND timeline_ms BETWEEN CAST($__from AS INTEGER) AND CAST($__to AS INTEGER)

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT m.numeric_value AS "Fuel at start" FROM sample_metric AS m JOIN sample AS s ON s.device_id = m.device_id AND s.trip_id = m.trip_id AND s.sequence = m.sequence WHERE m.device_id = ${device:sqlstring} AND m.trip_id = ${trip:sqlstring} AND m.pid = '0x12F' AND s.timeline_ms BETWEEN CAST($__from AS INTEGER) AND CAST($__to AS INTEGER) ORDER BY s.sequence ASC LIMIT 1

panels.title: Fuel at start

targets.queryText: SELECT m.numeric_value AS "Fuel at end" FROM sample_metric AS m JOIN sample AS s ON s.device_id = m.device_id AND s.trip_id = m.trip_id AND s.sequence = m.sequence WHERE m.device_id = ${device:sqlstring} AND m.trip_id = ${trip:sqlstring} AND m.pid = '0x12F' AND s.timeline_ms BETWEEN CAST($__from AS INTEGER) AND CAST($__to AS INTEGER) ORDER BY s.sequence DESC LIMIT 1
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT m.numeric_value AS "Fuel at end" FROM sample_metric AS m JOIN sample AS s ON s.device_id = m.device_id AND s.trip_id = m.trip_id AND s.sequence = m.sequence WHERE m.device_id = ${device:sqlstring} AND m.trip_id = ${trip:sqlstring} AND m.pid = '0x12F' AND s.timeline_ms BETWEEN CAST($__from AS INTEGER) AND CAST($__to AS INTEGER) ORDER BY s.sequence DESC LIMIT 1

panels.title: Fuel at end

panels.description: First minus last stored fuel-level percentage in the selected range. Sensor quantisation can hide short-trip change.

targets.queryText: SELECT (first.numeric_value - last.numeric_value) AS "Fuel level change" FROM (SELECT m.numeric_value FROM sample_metric AS m JOIN sample AS s ON s.device_id = m.device_id AND s.trip_id = m.trip_id AND s.sequence = m.sequence WHERE m.device_id = ${device:sqlstring} AND m.trip_id = ${trip:sqlstring} AND m.pid = '0x12F' AND s.timeline_ms BETWEEN CAST($__from AS INTEGER) AND CAST($__to AS INTEGER) ORDER BY s.sequence ASC LIMIT 1) AS first, (SELECT m.numeric_value FROM sample_metric AS m JOIN sample AS s ON s.device_id = m.device_id AND s.trip_id = m.trip_id AND s.sequence = m.sequence WHERE m.device_id = ${device:sqlstring} AND m.trip_id = ${trip:sqlstring} AND m.pid = '0x12F' AND s.timeline_ms BETWEEN CAST($__from AS INTEGER) AND CAST($__to AS INTEGER) ORDER BY s.sequence DESC LIMIT 1) AS last
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT (first.numeric_value - last.numeric_value) AS "Fuel level change" FROM (SELECT m.numeric_value FROM sample_metric AS m JOIN sample AS s ON s.device_id = m.device_id AND s.trip_id = m.trip_id AND s.sequence = m.sequence WHERE m.device_id = ${device:sqlstring} AND m.trip_id = ${trip:sqlstring} AND m.pid = '0x12F' AND s.timeline_ms BETWEEN CAST($__from AS INTEGER) AND CAST($__to AS INTEGER) ORDER BY s.sequence ASC LIMIT 1) AS first, (SELECT m.numeric_value FROM sample_metric AS m JOIN sample AS s ON s.device_id = m.device_id AND s.trip_id = m.trip_id AND s.sequence = m.sequence WHERE m.device_id = ${device:sqlstring} AND m.trip_id = ${trip:sqlstring} AND m.pid = '0x12F' AND s.timeline_ms BETWEEN CAST($__from AS INTEGER) AND CAST($__to AS INTEGER) ORDER BY s.sequence DESC LIMIT 1) AS last

targets.queryText: SELECT MAX(acceleration_x_g) AS "Peak acceleration (X)" FROM sample WHERE device_id = ${device:sqlstring} AND trip_id = ${trip:sqlstring} AND timeline_ms BETWEEN CAST($__from AS INTEGER) AND CAST($__to AS INTEGER)
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT MAX(acceleration_x_g) AS "Peak acceleration (X)" FROM sample WHERE device_id = ${device:sqlstring} AND trip_id = ${trip:sqlstring} AND timeline_ms BETWEEN CAST($__from AS INTEGER) AND CAST($__to AS INTEGER)

panels.title: Peak acceleration

targets.queryText: SELECT ABS(MIN(acceleration_x_g)) AS "Peak braking (X)" FROM sample WHERE device_id = ${device:sqlstring} AND trip_id = ${trip:sqlstring} AND timeline_ms BETWEEN CAST($__from AS INTEGER) AND CAST($__to AS INTEGER)
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT ABS(MIN(acceleration_x_g)) AS "Peak braking (X)" FROM sample WHERE device_id = ${device:sqlstring} AND trip_id = ${trip:sqlstring} AND timeline_ms BETWEEN CAST($__from AS INTEGER) AND CAST($__to AS INTEGER)

targets.queryText: SELECT MAX(m.numeric_value) AS "Maximum coolant" FROM sample_metric AS m JOIN sample AS s ON s.device_id = m.device_id AND s.trip_id = m.trip_id AND s.sequence = m.sequence WHERE m.device_id = ${device:sqlstring} AND m.trip_id = ${trip:sqlstring} AND m.pid = '0x105' AND timeline_ms BETWEEN CAST($__from AS INTEGER) AND CAST($__to AS INTEGER)
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT MAX(m.numeric_value) AS "Maximum coolant" FROM sample_metric AS m JOIN sample AS s ON s.device_id = m.device_id AND s.trip_id = m.trip_id AND s.sequence = m.sequence WHERE m.device_id = ${device:sqlstring} AND m.trip_id = ${trip:sqlstring} AND m.pid = '0x105' AND timeline_ms BETWEEN CAST($__from AS INTEGER) AND CAST($__to AS INTEGER)

panels.title: Maximum coolant

panels.description: One row per collector trip in the dashboard time range. Use the Trip selector for a detailed route and metric investigation.

targets.queryText: SELECT trip_id AS "Trip", device_id AS "Vehicle", datetime(timeline_start_ms / 1000, 'unixepoch') AS "Timeline start", datetime(timeline_end_ms / 1000, 'unixepoch') AS "Timeline end", timestamp_quality AS "Capture timestamp quality", time_basis AS "Display time basis", sample_count AS "Samples", gap_count AS "Gaps", gps_fix_count AS "GPS fixes", gps_poor_quality_count AS "Poor HDOP", speed_disagreement_count AS "Speed disagreements", archive_path AS "Archive" FROM trip WHERE device_id = ${device:sqlstring} AND (timeline_start_ms IS NULL OR timeline_start_ms BETWEEN CAST($__from AS INTEGER) AND CAST($__to AS INTEGER)) ORDER BY timeline_start_ms DESC
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT trip_id AS "Trip", device_id AS "Vehicle", datetime(timeline_start_ms / 1000, 'unixepoch') AS "Timeline start", datetime(timeline_end_ms / 1000, 'unixepoch') AS "Timeline end", timestamp_quality AS "Capture timestamp quality", time_basis AS "Display time basis", sample_count AS "Samples", gap_count AS "Gaps", gps_fix_count AS "GPS fixes", gps_poor_quality_count AS "Poor HDOP", speed_disagreement_count AS "Speed disagreements", archive_path AS "Archive" FROM trip WHERE device_id = ${device:sqlstring} AND (timeline_start_ms IS NULL OR timeline_start_ms BETWEEN CAST($__from AS INTEGER) AND CAST($__to AS INTEGER)) ORDER BY timeline_start_ms DESC

panels.title: Trip index

panels.description: GPS route for the selected trip and time range. No line is shown until a valid outdoor fix is received.

targets.queryText: SELECT s.timeline_ms / 1000.0 AS time, s.latitude AS "Latitude", s.longitude AS "Longitude", s.gps_speed_kph * 0.621371 AS "GPS speed (mph)", s.gps_heading_degrees AS "Heading", (SELECT numeric_value * 0.621371 FROM sample_metric WHERE device_id = s.device_id AND trip_id = s.trip_id AND sequence = s.sequence AND pid = '0x10D') AS "OBD speed (mph)", (SELECT numeric_value FROM sample_metric WHERE device_id = s.device_id AND trip_id = s.trip_id AND sequence = s.sequence AND pid = '0x10C') AS "RPM", (SELECT numeric_value FROM sample_metric WHERE device_id = s.device_id AND trip_id = s.trip_id AND sequence = s.sequence AND pid = '0x12F') AS "Fuel %", s.sequence AS "Sample", s.device_monotonic_ms AS "Device monotonic (ms)", s.collector_received_ms AS "Collector receipt (per-sample, if available)", s.archive_mtime_ms AS "Archive mtime (ms)", s.capture_utc_ms AS "Capture UTC (ms)", s.timestamp_quality AS "Capture timestamp quality", s.time_basis AS "Display time basis" FROM sample AS s WHERE s.device_id = ${device:sqlstring} AND s.trip_id = ${trip:sqlstring} AND s.latitude IS NOT NULL AND s.longitude IS NOT NULL AND s.timeline_ms BETWEEN CAST($__from AS INTEGER) AND CAST($__to AS INTEGER) ORDER BY sequence
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT s.timeline_ms / 1000.0 AS time, s.latitude AS "Latitude", s.longitude AS "Longitude", s.gps_speed_kph * 0.621371 AS "GPS speed (mph)", s.gps_heading_degrees AS "Heading", (SELECT numeric_value * 0.621371 FROM sample_metric WHERE device_id = s.device_id AND trip_id = s.trip_id AND sequence = s.sequence AND pid = '0x10D') AS "OBD speed (mph)", (SELECT numeric_value FROM sample_metric WHERE device_id = s.device_id AND trip_id = s.trip_id AND sequence = s.sequence AND pid = '0x10C') AS "RPM", (SELECT numeric_value FROM sample_metric WHERE device_id = s.device_id AND trip_id = s.trip_id AND sequence = s.sequence AND pid = '0x12F') AS "Fuel %", s.sequence AS "Sample", s.device_monotonic_ms AS "Device monotonic (ms)", s.collector_received_ms AS "Collector receipt (per-sample, if available)", s.archive_mtime_ms AS "Archive mtime (ms)", s.capture_utc_ms AS "Capture UTC (ms)", s.timestamp_quality AS "Capture timestamp quality", s.time_basis AS "Display time basis" FROM sample AS s WHERE s.device_id = ${device:sqlstring} AND s.trip_id = ${trip:sqlstring} AND s.latitude IS NOT NULL AND s.longitude IS NOT NULL AND s.timeline_ms BETWEEN CAST($__from AS INTEGER) AND CAST($__to AS INTEGER) ORDER BY sequence

panels.title: Trip route

panels.description: UK display units: OBD and GPS speed are shown in mph; RPM uses the right axis. Gaps remain visible instead of being invented.

targets.queryText: SELECT s.timeline_ms / 1000.0 AS time, MAX(CASE WHEN m.pid = '0x10D' THEN m.numeric_value * 0.621371 END) AS "OBD speed (mph)", MAX(CASE WHEN m.pid = '0x10C' THEN m.numeric_value END) AS "Engine RPM", MAX(s.gps_speed_kph * 0.621371) AS "GPS speed (mph)" FROM sample AS s LEFT JOIN sample_metric AS m ON m.device_id = s.device_id AND m.trip_id = s.trip_id AND m.sequence = s.sequence WHERE s.device_id = ${device:sqlstring} AND s.trip_id = ${trip:sqlstring} AND s.timeline_ms BETWEEN CAST($__from AS INTEGER) AND CAST($__to AS INTEGER) GROUP BY s.trip_id, s.sequence, s.timeline_ms ORDER BY time
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT s.timeline_ms / 1000.0 AS time, MAX(CASE WHEN m.pid = '0x10D' THEN m.numeric_value * 0.621371 END) AS "OBD speed (mph)", MAX(CASE WHEN m.pid = '0x10C' THEN m.numeric_value END) AS "Engine RPM", MAX(s.gps_speed_kph * 0.621371) AS "GPS speed (mph)" FROM sample AS s LEFT JOIN sample_metric AS m ON m.device_id = s.device_id AND m.trip_id = s.trip_id AND m.sequence = s.sequence WHERE s.device_id = ${device:sqlstring} AND s.trip_id = ${trip:sqlstring} AND s.timeline_ms BETWEEN CAST($__from AS INTEGER) AND CAST($__to AS INTEGER) GROUP BY s.trip_id, s.sequence, s.timeline_ms ORDER BY time

panels.title: Road speed and engine speed

panels.description: Stored MEMS acceleration X, Y and Z components. Missing vectors remain gaps rather than zero.

targets.queryText: SELECT timeline_ms / 1000.0 AS time, acceleration_x_g AS "X axis (g)", acceleration_y_g AS "Y axis (g)", acceleration_z_g AS "Z axis (g)" FROM sample WHERE device_id = ${device:sqlstring} AND trip_id = ${trip:sqlstring} AND timeline_ms BETWEEN CAST($__from AS INTEGER) AND CAST($__to AS INTEGER) ORDER BY time
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT timeline_ms / 1000.0 AS time, acceleration_x_g AS "X axis (g)", acceleration_y_g AS "Y axis (g)", acceleration_z_g AS "Z axis (g)" FROM sample WHERE device_id = ${device:sqlstring} AND trip_id = ${trip:sqlstring} AND timeline_ms BETWEEN CAST($__from AS INTEGER) AND CAST($__to AS INTEGER) ORDER BY time

panels.title: Acceleration by device axis

panels.description: Stored engine load and throttle position in the selected range. Missing PID samples remain gaps.

targets.queryText: SELECT s.timeline_ms / 1000.0 AS time, MAX(CASE WHEN m.pid = '0x104' THEN m.numeric_value END) AS "Engine load", MAX(CASE WHEN m.pid = '0x111' THEN m.numeric_value END) AS "Throttle" FROM sample AS s LEFT JOIN sample_metric AS m ON m.device_id = s.device_id AND m.trip_id = s.trip_id AND m.sequence = s.sequence WHERE s.device_id = ${device:sqlstring} AND s.trip_id = ${trip:sqlstring} AND s.timeline_ms BETWEEN CAST($__from AS INTEGER) AND CAST($__to AS INTEGER) GROUP BY s.trip_id, s.sequence, s.timeline_ms ORDER BY time
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT s.timeline_ms / 1000.0 AS time, MAX(CASE WHEN m.pid = '0x104' THEN m.numeric_value END) AS "Engine load", MAX(CASE WHEN m.pid = '0x111' THEN m.numeric_value END) AS "Throttle" FROM sample AS s LEFT JOIN sample_metric AS m ON m.device_id = s.device_id AND m.trip_id = s.trip_id AND m.sequence = s.sequence WHERE s.device_id = ${device:sqlstring} AND s.trip_id = ${trip:sqlstring} AND s.timeline_ms BETWEEN CAST($__from AS INTEGER) AND CAST($__to AS INTEGER) GROUP BY s.trip_id, s.sequence, s.timeline_ms ORDER BY time

panels.title: Engine load and throttle

panels.description: Stored coolant and intake-air temperatures in the selected range. Missing PID samples remain gaps.

targets.queryText: SELECT s.timeline_ms / 1000.0 AS time, MAX(CASE WHEN m.pid = '0x105' THEN m.numeric_value END) AS "Coolant", MAX(CASE WHEN m.pid = '0x10F' THEN m.numeric_value END) AS "Intake temperature" FROM sample AS s LEFT JOIN sample_metric AS m ON m.device_id = s.device_id AND m.trip_id = s.trip_id AND m.sequence = s.sequence WHERE s.device_id = ${device:sqlstring} AND s.trip_id = ${trip:sqlstring} AND s.timeline_ms BETWEEN CAST($__from AS INTEGER) AND CAST($__to AS INTEGER) GROUP BY s.trip_id, s.sequence, s.timeline_ms ORDER BY time
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT s.timeline_ms / 1000.0 AS time, MAX(CASE WHEN m.pid = '0x105' THEN m.numeric_value END) AS "Coolant", MAX(CASE WHEN m.pid = '0x10F' THEN m.numeric_value END) AS "Intake temperature" FROM sample AS s LEFT JOIN sample_metric AS m ON m.device_id = s.device_id AND m.trip_id = s.trip_id AND m.sequence = s.sequence WHERE s.device_id = ${device:sqlstring} AND s.trip_id = ${trip:sqlstring} AND s.timeline_ms BETWEEN CAST($__from AS INTEGER) AND CAST($__to AS INTEGER) GROUP BY s.trip_id, s.sequence, s.timeline_ms ORDER BY time

panels.title: Engine temperatures

panels.description: Stored fuel-tank percentage and fuel trims in the selected range. Fuel percentage is not a volume measurement.

targets.queryText: SELECT s.timeline_ms / 1000.0 AS time, MAX(CASE WHEN m.pid = '0x12F' THEN m.numeric_value END) AS "Fuel level", MAX(CASE WHEN m.pid IN ('0x106', '0x107') THEN m.numeric_value END) AS "Fuel trim" FROM sample AS s LEFT JOIN sample_metric AS m ON m.device_id = s.device_id AND m.trip_id = s.trip_id AND m.sequence = s.sequence WHERE s.device_id = ${device:sqlstring} AND s.trip_id = ${trip:sqlstring} AND s.timeline_ms BETWEEN CAST($__from AS INTEGER) AND CAST($__to AS INTEGER) GROUP BY s.trip_id, s.sequence, s.timeline_ms ORDER BY time
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT s.timeline_ms / 1000.0 AS time, MAX(CASE WHEN m.pid = '0x12F' THEN m.numeric_value END) AS "Fuel level", MAX(CASE WHEN m.pid IN ('0x106', '0x107') THEN m.numeric_value END) AS "Fuel trim" FROM sample AS s LEFT JOIN sample_metric AS m ON m.device_id = s.device_id AND m.trip_id = s.trip_id AND m.sequence = s.sequence WHERE s.device_id = ${device:sqlstring} AND s.trip_id = ${trip:sqlstring} AND s.timeline_ms BETWEEN CAST($__from AS INTEGER) AND CAST($__to AS INTEGER) GROUP BY s.trip_id, s.sequence, s.timeline_ms ORDER BY time

panels.title: Fuel level and trim

panels.description: Stored mass-airflow readings in the selected range. No pressure series is included in this historical query.

targets.queryText: SELECT s.timeline_ms / 1000.0 AS time, MAX(CASE WHEN m.pid = '0x110' THEN m.numeric_value END) AS "Mass airflow" FROM sample AS s LEFT JOIN sample_metric AS m ON m.device_id = s.device_id AND m.trip_id = s.trip_id AND m.sequence = s.sequence WHERE s.device_id = ${device:sqlstring} AND s.trip_id = ${trip:sqlstring} AND s.timeline_ms BETWEEN CAST($__from AS INTEGER) AND CAST($__to AS INTEGER) GROUP BY s.trip_id, s.sequence, s.timeline_ms ORDER BY time
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT s.timeline_ms / 1000.0 AS time, MAX(CASE WHEN m.pid = '0x110' THEN m.numeric_value END) AS "Mass airflow" FROM sample AS s LEFT JOIN sample_metric AS m ON m.device_id = s.device_id AND m.trip_id = s.trip_id AND m.sequence = s.sequence WHERE s.device_id = ${device:sqlstring} AND s.trip_id = ${trip:sqlstring} AND s.timeline_ms BETWEEN CAST($__from AS INTEGER) AND CAST($__to AS INTEGER) GROUP BY s.trip_id, s.sequence, s.timeline_ms ORDER BY time

panels.title: Mass airflow

panels.description: Stored satellite count, HDOP and GPS speed. HDOP is decoded from the wire value in tenths; missing GNSS fields remain gaps.

targets.queryText: SELECT timeline_ms / 1000.0 AS time, gps_satellites AS "Satellites", gps_hdop AS "HDOP", gps_speed_kph * 0.621371 AS "GPS speed (mph)" FROM sample WHERE device_id = ${device:sqlstring} AND trip_id = ${trip:sqlstring} AND timeline_ms BETWEEN CAST($__from AS INTEGER) AND CAST($__to AS INTEGER) ORDER BY time
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT timeline_ms / 1000.0 AS time, gps_satellites AS "Satellites", gps_hdop AS "HDOP", gps_speed_kph * 0.621371 AS "GPS speed (mph)" FROM sample WHERE device_id = ${device:sqlstring} AND trip_id = ${trip:sqlstring} AND timeline_ms BETWEEN CAST($__from AS INTEGER) AND CAST($__to AS INTEGER) ORDER BY time

panels.title: GPS quality

panels.description: Stored ECU fuel rate and mass airflow, plus direct ECU and petrol-assumption MAF economy only when OBD speed and the required source are present. No GPS fallback is used.

targets.queryText: SELECT s.timeline_ms / 1000.0 AS time, MAX(CASE WHEN m.pid = '0x15E' THEN m.numeric_value END) AS "ECU fuel rate", MAX(CASE WHEN m.pid = '0x110' THEN m.numeric_value END) AS "Mass airflow", CASE WHEN MAX(CASE WHEN m.pid = '0x10D' THEN m.numeric_value END) IS NOT NULL AND MAX(CASE WHEN m.pid = '0x15E' THEN m.numeric_value END) > 0 THEN MAX(CASE WHEN m.pid = '0x10D' THEN m.numeric_value END) * 2.82480848939 / MAX(CASE WHEN m.pid = '0x15E' THEN m.numeric_value END) END AS "ECU economy (UK mpg)", CASE WHEN MAX(CASE WHEN m.pid = '0x10D' THEN m.numeric_value END) IS NOT NULL AND MAX(CASE WHEN m.pid = '0x110' THEN m.numeric_value END) > 0 THEN MAX(CASE WHEN m.pid = '0x10D' THEN m.numeric_value END) * 2.82480848939 / (MAX(CASE WHEN m.pid = '0x110' THEN m.numeric_value END) * 3600.0 / 10951.5) END AS "MAF economy estimate (UK mpg)" FROM sample AS s LEFT JOIN sample_metric AS m ON m.device_id = s.device_id AND m.trip_id = s.trip_id AND m.sequence = s.sequence WHERE s.device_id = ${device:sqlstring} AND s.trip_id = ${trip:sqlstring} AND s.timeline_ms BETWEEN CAST($__from AS INTEGER) AND CAST($__to AS INTEGER) GROUP BY s.trip_id, s.sequence, s.timeline_ms ORDER BY time
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT s.timeline_ms / 1000.0 AS time, MAX(CASE WHEN m.pid = '0x15E' THEN m.numeric_value END) AS "ECU fuel rate", MAX(CASE WHEN m.pid = '0x110' THEN m.numeric_value END) AS "Mass airflow", CASE WHEN MAX(CASE WHEN m.pid = '0x10D' THEN m.numeric_value END) IS NOT NULL AND MAX(CASE WHEN m.pid = '0x15E' THEN m.numeric_value END) > 0 THEN MAX(CASE WHEN m.pid = '0x10D' THEN m.numeric_value END) * 2.82480848939 / MAX(CASE WHEN m.pid = '0x15E' THEN m.numeric_value END) END AS "ECU economy (UK mpg)", CASE WHEN MAX(CASE WHEN m.pid = '0x10D' THEN m.numeric_value END) IS NOT NULL AND MAX(CASE WHEN m.pid = '0x110' THEN m.numeric_value END) > 0 THEN MAX(CASE WHEN m.pid = '0x10D' THEN m.numeric_value END) * 2.82480848939 / (MAX(CASE WHEN m.pid = '0x110' THEN m.numeric_value END) * 3600.0 / 10951.5) END AS "MAF economy estimate (UK mpg)" FROM sample AS s LEFT JOIN sample_metric AS m ON m.device_id = s.device_id AND m.trip_id = s.trip_id AND m.sequence = s.sequence WHERE s.device_id = ${device:sqlstring} AND s.trip_id = ${trip:sqlstring} AND s.timeline_ms BETWEEN CAST($__from AS INTEGER) AND CAST($__to AS INTEGER) GROUP BY s.trip_id, s.sequence, s.timeline_ms ORDER BY time

panels.title: Fuel rate and economy

panels.description: Historical numeric and text metric inventory with catalogue metadata and explicit sample counts. Raw duplicate fields remain in field_timeline.

targets.queryText: SELECT m.pid AS "PID", COALESCE(c.name, 'Unknown metric') AS "Metric", c.description AS "Description", c.unit AS "Unit", COUNT(m.numeric_value) AS "Numeric samples", COUNT(m.text_value) AS "Text samples", MIN(m.numeric_value) AS "Minimum", AVG(m.numeric_value) AS "Average", MAX(m.numeric_value) AS "Maximum" FROM sample_metric AS m JOIN sample AS s ON s.device_id = m.device_id AND s.trip_id = m.trip_id AND s.sequence = m.sequence LEFT JOIN metric_catalogue AS c ON c.pid = m.pid WHERE m.device_id = ${device:sqlstring} AND m.trip_id = ${trip:sqlstring} AND s.timeline_ms BETWEEN CAST($__from AS INTEGER) AND CAST($__to AS INTEGER) GROUP BY m.pid, c.name, c.description, c.unit ORDER BY m.pid
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT m.pid AS "PID", COALESCE(c.name, 'Unknown metric') AS "Metric", c.description AS "Description", c.unit AS "Unit", COUNT(m.numeric_value) AS "Numeric samples", COUNT(m.text_value) AS "Text samples", MIN(m.numeric_value) AS "Minimum", AVG(m.numeric_value) AS "Average", MAX(m.numeric_value) AS "Maximum" FROM sample_metric AS m JOIN sample AS s ON s.device_id = m.device_id AND s.trip_id = m.trip_id AND s.sequence = m.sequence LEFT JOIN metric_catalogue AS c ON c.pid = m.pid WHERE m.device_id = ${device:sqlstring} AND m.trip_id = ${trip:sqlstring} AND s.timeline_ms BETWEEN CAST($__from AS INTEGER) AND CAST($__to AS INTEGER) GROUP BY m.pid, c.name, c.description, c.unit ORDER BY m.pid

panels.title: Historical metric inventory

panels.description: Stored timing advance and commanded air-fuel equivalence ratio. Oxygen-sensor voltage is not included in this historical query.

targets.queryText: SELECT s.timeline_ms / 1000.0 AS time, MAX(CASE WHEN m.pid = '0x10E' THEN m.numeric_value END) AS "Timing advance", MAX(CASE WHEN m.pid = '0x144' THEN m.numeric_value END) AS "Equivalence ratio" FROM sample AS s LEFT JOIN sample_metric AS m ON m.device_id = s.device_id AND m.trip_id = s.trip_id AND m.sequence = s.sequence WHERE s.device_id = ${device:sqlstring} AND s.trip_id = ${trip:sqlstring} AND s.timeline_ms BETWEEN CAST($__from AS INTEGER) AND CAST($__to AS INTEGER) GROUP BY s.trip_id, s.sequence, s.timeline_ms ORDER BY time
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT s.timeline_ms / 1000.0 AS time, MAX(CASE WHEN m.pid = '0x10E' THEN m.numeric_value END) AS "Timing advance", MAX(CASE WHEN m.pid = '0x144' THEN m.numeric_value END) AS "Equivalence ratio" FROM sample AS s LEFT JOIN sample_metric AS m ON m.device_id = s.device_id AND m.trip_id = s.trip_id AND m.sequence = s.sequence WHERE s.device_id = ${device:sqlstring} AND s.trip_id = ${trip:sqlstring} AND s.timeline_ms BETWEEN CAST($__from AS INTEGER) AND CAST($__to AS INTEGER) GROUP BY s.trip_id, s.sequence, s.timeline_ms ORDER BY time

panels.title: Timing and equivalence ratio

panels.description: Latest stored numeric value per PID by sample sequence within the selected range; this is not a maximum-value summary.

targets.queryText: SELECT latest.pid AS "PID", latest.numeric_value AS "Latest" FROM sample_metric AS latest JOIN sample AS latest_sample ON latest_sample.device_id = latest.device_id AND latest_sample.trip_id = latest.trip_id AND latest_sample.sequence = latest.sequence WHERE latest.device_id = ${device:sqlstring} AND latest.trip_id = ${trip:sqlstring} AND latest.numeric_value IS NOT NULL AND latest_sample.timeline_ms BETWEEN CAST($__from AS INTEGER) AND CAST($__to AS INTEGER) AND latest.sequence = (SELECT MAX(candidate.sequence) FROM sample_metric AS candidate JOIN sample AS candidate_sample ON candidate_sample.device_id = candidate.device_id AND candidate_sample.trip_id = candidate.trip_id AND candidate_sample.sequence = candidate.sequence WHERE candidate.device_id = latest.device_id AND candidate.trip_id = latest.trip_id AND candidate.pid = latest.pid AND candidate.numeric_value IS NOT NULL AND candidate_sample.timeline_ms BETWEEN CAST($__from AS INTEGER) AND CAST($__to AS INTEGER)) ORDER BY latest.pid
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT latest.pid AS "PID", latest.numeric_value AS "Latest" FROM sample_metric AS latest JOIN sample AS latest_sample ON latest_sample.device_id = latest.device_id AND latest_sample.trip_id = latest.trip_id AND latest_sample.sequence = latest.sequence WHERE latest.device_id = ${device:sqlstring} AND latest.trip_id = ${trip:sqlstring} AND latest.numeric_value IS NOT NULL AND latest_sample.timeline_ms BETWEEN CAST($__from AS INTEGER) AND CAST($__to AS INTEGER) AND latest.sequence = (SELECT MAX(candidate.sequence) FROM sample_metric AS candidate JOIN sample AS candidate_sample ON candidate_sample.device_id = candidate.device_id AND candidate_sample.trip_id = candidate.trip_id AND candidate_sample.sequence = candidate.sequence WHERE candidate.device_id = latest.device_id AND candidate.trip_id = latest.trip_id AND candidate.pid = latest.pid AND candidate.numeric_value IS NOT NULL AND candidate_sample.timeline_ms BETWEEN CAST($__from AS INTEGER) AND CAST($__to AS INTEGER)) ORDER BY latest.pid

panels.description: Durable trip history from SQLite. Capture-time quality, display-time basis, sample count and archive path remain visible; missing capture timestamps stay unknown.

targets.queryText: SELECT trip_id AS "Trip", device_id AS "Vehicle", datetime(timeline_start_ms / 1000, 'unixepoch') AS "Timeline start", datetime(timeline_end_ms / 1000, 'unixepoch') AS "Timeline end", timestamp_quality AS "Capture timestamp quality", time_basis AS "Display time basis", sample_count AS "Samples", gap_count AS "Gaps", gps_fix_count AS "GPS fixes", gps_poor_quality_count AS "Poor HDOP", speed_disagreement_count AS "Speed disagreements", archive_path AS "Archive" FROM trip WHERE device_id = ${device:sqlstring} AND (timeline_start_ms IS NULL OR timeline_start_ms BETWEEN CAST($__from AS INTEGER) AND CAST($__to AS INTEGER)) ORDER BY timeline_start_ms DESC
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT trip_id AS "Trip", device_id AS "Vehicle", datetime(timeline_start_ms / 1000, 'unixepoch') AS "Timeline start", datetime(timeline_end_ms / 1000, 'unixepoch') AS "Timeline end", timestamp_quality AS "Capture timestamp quality", time_basis AS "Display time basis", sample_count AS "Samples", gap_count AS "Gaps", gps_fix_count AS "GPS fixes", gps_poor_quality_count AS "Poor HDOP", speed_disagreement_count AS "Speed disagreements", archive_path AS "Archive" FROM trip WHERE device_id = ${device:sqlstring} AND (timeline_start_ms IS NULL OR timeline_start_ms BETWEEN CAST($__from AS INTEGER) AND CAST($__to AS INTEGER)) ORDER BY timeline_start_ms DESC

panels.title: Durable trip archive (SQLite)

panels.description: Decoded stored, pending and permanent DTC detail from the raw archive. No rows means no decodable code was recorded; raw fields remain in the metric timeline.

targets.queryText: SELECT d.sequence AS "Sample", d.status AS "Status", d.slot AS "Slot", d.code AS "Code", d.system AS "System", d.raw_code AS "Raw code", s.timeline_ms AS "Display time (ms)", s.capture_utc_ms AS "Capture UTC (ms)", s.timestamp_quality AS "Timestamp quality", s.time_basis AS "Display time basis" FROM diagnostic_code AS d JOIN sample AS s ON s.device_id = d.device_id AND s.trip_id = d.trip_id AND s.sequence = d.sequence WHERE d.device_id = ${device:sqlstring} AND d.trip_id = ${trip:sqlstring} AND s.timeline_ms BETWEEN CAST($__from AS INTEGER) AND CAST($__to AS INTEGER) ORDER BY s.sequence, d.status, d.slot LIMIT 5000
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT d.sequence AS "Sample", d.status AS "Status", d.slot AS "Slot", d.code AS "Code", d.system AS "System", d.raw_code AS "Raw code", s.timeline_ms AS "Display time (ms)", s.capture_utc_ms AS "Capture UTC (ms)", s.timestamp_quality AS "Timestamp quality", s.time_basis AS "Display time basis" FROM diagnostic_code AS d JOIN sample AS s ON s.device_id = d.device_id AND s.trip_id = d.trip_id AND s.sequence = d.sequence WHERE d.device_id = ${device:sqlstring} AND d.trip_id = ${trip:sqlstring} AND s.timeline_ms BETWEEN CAST($__from AS INTEGER) AND CAST($__to AS INTEGER) ORDER BY s.sequence, d.status, d.slot LIMIT 5000

panels.title: Diagnostic trouble code detail

panels.description: Capture evidence from the durable archive. Unknown capture timestamps remain NULL; display time, archive mtime and device monotonic time are shown separately. Per-sample receipt lag is unavailable until the collector records a receipt ledger.

targets.queryText: SELECT s.sequence AS "Sample", t.timestamp_quality AS "Trip timestamp quality", s.timestamp_quality AS "Sample timestamp quality", s.device_monotonic_ms AS "Device monotonic (ms)", s.capture_utc_ms AS "Capture UTC (ms)", s.timeline_ms AS "Display time (ms)", s.time_basis AS "Display time basis", s.collector_received_ms AS "Collector receipt (per-sample, if available)", s.archive_mtime_ms AS "Archive mtime (ms)", NULL AS "Receipt lag (ms; not instrumented)", g.gap_ms AS "Gap from previous (ms)", t.gap_count AS "Trip gaps" FROM sample AS s JOIN trip AS t ON t.device_id = s.device_id AND t.trip_id = s.trip_id LEFT JOIN sample_gaps AS g ON g.device_id = s.device_id AND g.trip_id = s.trip_id AND g.sequence = s.sequence WHERE s.device_id = ${device:sqlstring} AND s.trip_id = ${trip:sqlstring} AND s.timeline_ms BETWEEN CAST($__from AS INTEGER) AND CAST($__to AS INTEGER) ORDER BY s.sequence LIMIT 5000
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT s.sequence AS "Sample", t.timestamp_quality AS "Trip timestamp quality", s.timestamp_quality AS "Sample timestamp quality", s.device_monotonic_ms AS "Device monotonic (ms)", s.capture_utc_ms AS "Capture UTC (ms)", s.timeline_ms AS "Display time (ms)", s.time_basis AS "Display time basis", s.collector_received_ms AS "Collector receipt (per-sample, if available)", s.archive_mtime_ms AS "Archive mtime (ms)", NULL AS "Receipt lag (ms; not instrumented)", g.gap_ms AS "Gap from previous (ms)", t.gap_count AS "Trip gaps" FROM sample AS s JOIN trip AS t ON t.device_id = s.device_id AND t.trip_id = s.trip_id LEFT JOIN sample_gaps AS g ON g.device_id = s.device_id AND g.trip_id = s.trip_id AND g.sequence = s.sequence WHERE s.device_id = ${device:sqlstring} AND s.trip_id = ${trip:sqlstring} AND s.timeline_ms BETWEEN CAST($__from AS INTEGER) AND CAST($__to AS INTEGER) ORDER BY s.sequence LIMIT 5000

panels.title: Capture evidence, timestamp quality and gaps

panels.description: Integrity metadata for the selected raw archive. The raw .txt file remains canonical; a mutation flag means the sealed archive changed after indexing, while differing byte counts mean the projection is incomplete.

targets.queryText: SELECT i.archive_path AS "Archive", i.content_sha256 AS "SHA-256", i.byte_size AS "Raw bytes", i.processed_bytes AS "Indexed bytes", i.sealed AS "Sealed", i.mutation_detected AS "Mutation detected", datetime(i.indexed_at_ms / 1000, 'unixepoch') AS "Indexed at" FROM ingest_file AS i JOIN trip AS t ON t.archive_path = i.archive_path WHERE t.device_id = ${device:sqlstring} AND t.trip_id = ${trip:sqlstring}
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT i.archive_path AS "Archive", i.content_sha256 AS "SHA-256", i.byte_size AS "Raw bytes", i.processed_bytes AS "Indexed bytes", i.sealed AS "Sealed", i.mutation_detected AS "Mutation detected", datetime(i.indexed_at_ms / 1000, 'unixepoch') AS "Indexed at" FROM ingest_file AS i JOIN trip AS t ON t.archive_path = i.archive_path WHERE t.device_id = ${device:sqlstring} AND t.trip_id = ${trip:sqlstring}
